title: Data Engineer ( Mid Level )
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Mid-Level Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data processing solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong programming and SQL skills, hands-on experience with Python, Databricks, PySpark, and Delta Lake, and a solid understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data integration. The candidate will work on implementing Medallion Architecture, developing incremental data pipelines, integrating external APIs, and building reliable data processing workflows across AWS and Microsoft Azure environments. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines for batch and incremental data processing. Build ETL/ELT workflows to extract, transform, validate, and load data from APIs, databases, files, and third-party platforms. Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database schemas. Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL. Develop data integration solutions using Python, REST APIs, and relevant cloud services. Build and maintain data processing pipelines using Databricks and PySpark. Implement Medallion Architecture with Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. Work with Delta Lake tables, schema evolution, and data transformation processes. Implement Change Data Capture (CDC) and incremental loading mechanisms. Handle data cleansing, validation, deduplication, reconciliation, and error handling. Develop API integration utilities and backend services using TypeScript and Node.js. Develop serverless functions using Azure Functions and support workflow orchestration using Durable Functions. Schedule, monitor, and troubleshoot data pipeline execution. Optimize query performance, Spark jobs, pipeline efficiency, and data storage. Collaborate with data analysts, backend developers, and business teams to understand requirements. Maintain technical documentation, data mappings, pipeline specifications, and operational procedures. Follow data security, access control, coding standards, and version control practices. Required Skills 3-5 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, or a related field. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Hands-on experience with Databricks and PySpark. Understanding of Medallion Architecture and Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers. Experience working with Delta Lake and Delta tables. Knowledge of ETL/ELT development, CDC, and incremental data loading. Experience integrating REST APIs and handling JSON, CSV, and other data formats. Working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. Experience with Azure Functions; familiarity with Durable Functions. Experience with relational databases and data modeling. Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS or Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD practices, logging, monitoring, and automated testing. Understanding of data quality checks, error handling, and pipeline troubleshooting. Preferred Skills Experience working with both AWS and Microsoft Azure. Familiarity with Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, and Amazon CloudWatch. Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2), and Azure Monitor. Experience with Databricks Workflows and job scheduling. Knowledge of Delta Lake optimization and schema evolution. Exposure to Docker and cloud-based data platforms. Experience with BI and analytics tools such as Power BI or Tableau. Familiarity with data governance, data lineage, and automated data reconciliation. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Success Criteria Reliable and maintainable data pipelines. Accurate, consistent, and timely data delivery. Improved SQL, Spark, and pipeline performance. Reduced pipeline failures and effective issue resolution. High-quality, reusable, and well-documented code. Successful delivery of assigned engineering tasks within agreed timelines.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to lead the design, development, and optimization of scalable, secure, and high-performance data engineering solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, SQL, Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, CDC, and incremental data processing. The candidate will own data architecture decisions, design reusable data ingestion frameworks, implement Medallion Architecture, and develop reliable integration and orchestration solutions across AWS and Microsoft Azure. The role also involves building API integration services using TypeScript and Node.js, implementing serverless workflows using Azure Functions and Durable Functions, optimizing production workloads, establishing engineering best practices, and mentoring team members. Key ResponsibilitiesData Engineering and Architecture Design and lead the development of scalable data architectures and end-to-end data pipelines. Define data engineering standards, architectural patterns, reusable frameworks, and best practices. Build and optimize complex ETL/ELT workflows supporting large-scale data processing. Design data ingestion frameworks for databases, REST APIs, files, event streams, and third-party platforms. Develop reusable connectors supporting authentication, pagination, rate limits, retries, error handling, and incremental synchronization. Design and maintain data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and analytical data models. Optimize complex SQL queries, database schemas, partitioning strategies, and processing performance. Databricks, PySpark, and Delta Lake Design and optimize data processing solutions using Databricks, PySpark, and Delta Lake. Establish and maintain Medallion Architecture across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers. Define data ingestion, cleansing, standardization, enrichment, and aggregation strategies. Design Delta Lake tables and implement schema enforcement, schema evolution, and transactional data processing. Optimize Spark jobs, joins, partitioning, file sizes, and execution plans. Apply Delta Lake table optimization and maintenance strategies where appropriate. Develop curated datasets for business intelligence, analytics, and downstream applications. CDC and Incremental Data Processing Design and implement scalable Change Data Capture (CDC) and incremental loading frameworks. Handle inserts, updates, deletes, duplicate records, late-arriving data, and reprocessing scenarios. Implement watermarking, checkpointing, and recovery mechanisms. Ensure idempotent processing and reliable data consistency during retries and reprocessing. Establish source-to-target reconciliation and automated data quality validation. Design historical backfill, replay, and recovery strategies. Monitor data freshness, pipeline failures, and data quality issues. API Integration and Serverless Development Design reusable API integration frameworks using TypeScript, Node.js, and Python where appropriate. Develop secure and reliable connectors for third-party platforms and external data sources. Implement authentication, pagination, rate-limit management, retries, token refresh, and timeout handling. Design scalable serverless processing solutions using Azure Functions. Design orchestrated, long-running workflows using Azure Durable Functions. Implement workflow orchestration, retry policies, failure recovery, and parallel processing patterns where appropriate. Integrate serverless workflows with data pipelines, cloud storage, and downstream processing systems. Establish standards for API security, observability, performance, and maintainability. AWS and Azure Cloud Engineering Design, implement, and optimize data engineering solutions across AWS and Microsoft Azure. Select appropriate cloud services based on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost. Work with AWS services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, and Amazon CloudWatch, as applicable. Work with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, and Azure Monitor, as applicable. Implement secure access controls, identity management, encryption, and secrets management. Establish cloud monitoring, alerting, deployment, and operational standards. Optimize cloud resource utilization, storage costs, and data processing performance. Data Quality, Security, and Reliability Establish data quality standards, validation rules, automated tests, and reconciliation frameworks. Implement logging, metrics, monitoring, alerting, and pipeline observability. Ensure data accuracy, completeness, freshness, and availability. Follow security, privacy, access control, and data governance practices. Troubleshoot critical production issues and perform root-cause analysis. Improve pipeline resilience, recovery, and operational reliability. DevOps and Engineering Best Practices Drive CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, and release management. Establish Git workflows, code review standards, and maintainable coding practices. Support infrastructure automation and environment configuration management. Maintain architecture diagrams, technical documentation, data mappings, and operational runbooks. Evaluate technologies and recommend solutions based on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost. Technical Leadership and Collaboration Lead technical design reviews and architectural decisions. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing. Collaborate with product managers, architects, analysts, backend engineers, and business stakeholders. Translate business requirements into scalable technical data solutions. Identify performance bottlenecks, technical risks, and automation opportunities. Own end-to-end technical delivery and continuous improvement of data engineering solutions. Required Skills 6-10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering roles. Advanced proficiency in Python, SQL, and PySpark. Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and distributed data processing. Expertise in Medallion Architecture and lakehouse design. Strong experience with Delta Lake, schema evolution, transactional data processing, and table optimization. Proven experience designing CDC and incremental loading frameworks. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, data modeling, and source-to-target reconciliation. Experience developing API integration services using TypeScript and Node.js. Hands-on experience with Azure Functions and Azure Durable Functions. Strong expertise in at least one of AWS or Microsoft Azure, with practical experience in the other. Experience with cloud security, monitoring, logging, and cost optimization. Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and production deployment practices. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and technical decision-making skills. Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives. Preferred Skills Experience operating data platforms across both AWS and Azure. Experience with AWS Glue, Amazon S3, AWS Lambda, and CloudWatch. Experience with Azure Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, and Azure Monitor. Familiarity with Databricks Workflows and Unity Catalog. Experience with structured streaming and event-driven data processing where applicable. Knowledge of Terraform or other infrastructure automation tools. Experience with Docker and containerized services. Familiarity with data governance, lineage, metadata management, and data observability. Experience designing multi-tenant data platforms and reusable integration frameworks. Experience supporting analytics, reporting, and AI/ML data workloads. Qualifications Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Success Criteria Scalable, secure, and highly reliable data platform architecture. Improved pipeline performance, data quality, and system availability. Reduced production incidents and faster issue resolution. Optimized cloud infrastructure and data processing costs. Reusable data ingestion frameworks and consistent engineering standards. High-quality documentation, automated testing, and operational practices. Successful delivery of complex data engineering initiatives. Effective technical mentorship and cross-functional collaboration.

title: Sr Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 Senior Data Engineer As a Senior Data Engineer within our Enterprise Data and Analytics team, you'll be at the forefront of a company-wide digital transformation. We're looking for a forward-thinking engineer who brings deep technical expertise and a passion for building scalable, AI-ready data platforms. In this role, you'll architect and implement modern data solutions that power intelligent applications, streamline operations, and deliver measurable business value. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design robust pipelines, integrate diverse data sources, and enable advanced analytics and generative AI capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of data engineering at Charles River and help unlock the full potential of data to drive innovation in the life sciences. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Bricks, and other Azure services. Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Azure Data Lake, Azure SQL Database, and Delta Lake to support analytics and reporting needs. Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver high-quality, reliable datasets. Ensure data security, compliance, and governance by applying best practices, role-based access control (RBAC), and encryption. Monitor and troubleshoot data workflows, ensuring performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency across Azure cloud environments. Automate data integration and transformation tasks using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and scripting languages like Python. Mentor junior engineers and foster a collaborative team environment. 
 
 Essential Qualifications 
 Bachelor s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline 7+ years of experience in ETL design, development, and performance tuning using the Microsoft Stack in a multi-dimensional data warehousing environment. 7+ years of advanced SQL programming expertise (PL/SQL, T-SQL) 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Data Analytics solution architecture 3+ years of experience in Python Programming 3+ years of hands-on experience with Azure, especially for data-heavy/analytics applications leveraging relational and NoSQL databases, Data Warehousing, and Big Data solutions. 3+ years of experience with key Azure services: Azure Data Factory, Data Lake Gen2, Analysis Services, Databricks, Blob Storage, SQL Database, Cosmos DB, App Service, Logic Apps, and Functions 2+ years of experience designing data models aligning with business requirements and analytics needs. 2+ years of experience defining and implementing data security standards, including encryption, auditing, and monitoring. Strong analytical skills and a passion for intellectual curiosity 
 
 Preferred Skills 
 Familiarity with DevOps processes (CI/CD) and infrastructure as code Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Quality tools Experience developing REST APIs using Java Spring Boot, Python Experience building and supporting AL/ML software solutions Familiarity with stream-processing systems (e.g., Event Hubs, Storm, Spark-Streaming) Experience with API integrations (RESTful, SOAP) for both internal and external systems to enhance data flow and automation. Experience working in Agile environments, familiarity with Agile tools like Jira or Azure DevOps. Experience in data and analytics within the Life Sciences industry is a plus.

title: Data Engineer
description:
JD: Data Engineer: Responsibilities Data Platform Design & Architecture Work with Engineering Lead and maintain the firm's enterprise data warehouse on Microsoft Fabric covering Lakehouse, Warehouse, and Semantic layers end-to-end. Maintain medallion-pattern data pipelines (Bronze Silver Gold) that consolidate data from practice verticals, internal operations, and client-facing systems. Define and enforce logical and physical schema design standards, ensuring data structures are optimized for both analytical queries and downstream AI consumption. Maintain architecture decision records, solution blueprints, and platform documentation to enable scalable, auditable infrastructure. Pipeline Engineering & ETL/ELT Development Design, build, and operationalize robust ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark, Fabric Notebooks, and Fabric Data Factory — handling ingestion, transformation, validation, and load. Integrate diverse data sources — CRM, ERP, project management tools, financial systems, and cloud-based SaaS applications — into a unified data platform. Implement incremental and batch ingestion patterns; design fault-tolerant pipelines with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing retry logic. Build and maintain reusable pipeline templates and modular transformation logic to accelerate future development. Performance, Reliability & Platform Operations Own performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategies, and capacity planning across the Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse environments. Manage upgrade cycles, schema evolution, and version-controlled deployments using CI/CD best practices integrated with Azure DevOps. Implement SLA monitoring and data freshness alerting to ensure pipelines meet business-critical availability requirements. Conduct regular platform health reviews and proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks before they impact downstream consumers. Analytics Enablement & Semantic Layer Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) on top of the Gold layer — ensuring business-friendly naming, consistent measures, and row-level security. Enable self-service analytics for consultants and operations teams by creating well-documented, reusable datasets that reduce dependency on the data team. Collaborate with analysts and practice leads to translate KPI definitions into reliable, calculated measures within the semantic layer. Develop and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for practice performance, utilisation, revenue, and operational health. Technology repository Document and maintain the firm's data engineering playbooks, onboarding guides, and standards so the platform can scale as the team grows. Experience, Qualifications & Skills Must-Have 4-5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data platform development, or related roles. Deep, practical expertise with Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Fabric Notebooks, and OneLake. Proficiency in PySpark and SQL for large-scale data transformation, aggregation, and pipeline development. Proven experience designing and implementing Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architectures. Strong Python skills for scripting, automation, and data pipeline orchestration. Experience with Azure cloud services — Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps. Solid understanding of data warehousing principles — schema design, ETL/ELT best practices, data quality, and lineage. Experience building Power BI semantic models and BI dashboards from data engineering outputs. Good-to-Have Familiarity with Snowflake, Databricks, or other cloud-native data platforms. Exposure to data mesh architecture principles, data contracts, or federated governance models. Experience with streaming / real-time ingestion using Fabric Eventstream, Kafka, or Azure Event Hubs. Background in professional services, consulting, or internal analytics functions. Key Competencies MS Fabric (Lakehouse / Warehouse) Azure Data / Synapse PySpark / Spark Data Factory / Pipelines Power BI & Semantic Models Medallion Architecture ETL / ELT Design Python & SQL Data Governance & Lineage Schema Design Performance Tuning KPI Frameworks Educational Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Relevant certifications valued: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), or equivalent. A demonstrable portfolio of data platform builds, pipeline architectures, or open-source contributions is a compelling differentiator.
